spans.s:
लता लता, f. (said to be fr. a Sautra rt.
लत्), a creeper, creeping plant, winding plant in
general, (the brows, arms, curls, lightning, &c. are
frequently metaphorically compared to the form of
a creeper; cf. भ्रू-ल्˚, बाहु-ल्˚, तडिल्-ल्˚, &c.); a
plant of any kind; a branch; musk-creeper, = कस्तू-
रिका [cf. लता-कस्तूरिका below]; N. of various
plants, Panicum Italicum; Trigonella Corniculata;
Cardiospermum Halicacabum; Gærtnera Racemosa;
Panicum Dactylon; = कैवर्तिका; = सारिवा; the
thong or lash of a whip, a whip; a string or thread
of pearls; a slender or graceful woman; a woman
in general; N. of a metre, four times ˘˘˘˘˘˘
¯˘¯¯, ˘¯¯˘¯¯˘¯; N. of an Apsaras; of a
daughter of Meru and wife of llāvṛta.
—लता-कर,
अस्, m. a particular position of the hands in dancing.
—लता-करञ्ज, अस्, m. Guilandina Bonduc.
—लता-
कस्तूरिका or लता-कस्तूरी, f. musk-creeper, a kind
of aromatic medicinal plant or substance (said to
grow in the Dekhan).
—लता-गृह, अस्, अम्, m.
n. ‘creeper-house,’ a house or bower built or sur-
rounded with creepers, an arbour.
—लताङ्गी (˚ता-
अङ्˚), f. a kind of plant (= कर्कट-शृङ्गी).
—ल-
ताङ्गुलि (˚ता-अङ्˚), इस्, f. ‘creeper-finger,’ a branch
serving as a finger.
—लता-जिह्व, अस्, m. ‘creeper-
tongued,’ a snake.
—लता-तरु, उस्, m., N. of various
trees, Shorea Robusta; Borassus Flabelliformis; the
orange tree.
—लता-द्रुम, अस्, m. Shorea Robusta.
—लतानन (˚ता-आन्˚), अस्, m. a particular position
of the hands in dancing.
—लतान्त (˚ता-अन्˚), अम्,
n. ‘the end of a creeper,’ a flower.
—लता-पनस,
अस्, m. the water-melon.
—लता-पर्ण, अस्, m., N.
of Viṣṇu; (ई), f. Curculigo Orchioides; Trigonella
Fœnum Græcum.
—लता-पृक्का, f. Trigonella Cor-
niculata.
—लता-प्रतान, अस्, m. the tendril of a
creeper.
—लता-फल, अम्, n. the fruit of Tricho-
santhes Diœca.
—लता-भद्रा, f. Pæderia Fœtida.
—लता-भवन, अम्, n. an arbour (= लता-गृह).
—लता-मणि, इस्, m. ‘creeper-jewel,’ coral.
—लता-
मण्डप, अस्, m. ‘creeper-pavilion,’ an arbour,
bower.
—लता-मरुत्, त्, f. Trigonella Corniculata.
—लता-माधवी, f. the Mādhavī creeper, Gærtnera
Racemosa.
—लता-मृग, अस्, m. an ape, monkey.
—लताम्बुज (˚ता-अम्˚), अम्, n. a kind of cucum-
ber.
—लता-यष्टि, इस्, f. Bengal madder, Rubia
Munjista.
—लता-यावक, अम्, n. a shoot, sprout,
young or tender pasturage.
—लता-रसन, अस्, m.
‘creeper-tongued,’ a snake.
—लतार्क (˚ता-अर्˚), अस्,
m. a green onion.
—लतालक (˚ता-अल्), अस्, m. an
elephant.
—लतालय (˚ता-आल्˚), अस्, m. an abode or
dwelling made of creepers.
—लता-वलय, अस्, अम्,
m. n. = लता-गृह, an arbour.
—लतावलय-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of bowers or having bracelet-
[]
like creepers.
—लता-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the cocoa-nut
tree; Shorea Robusta.
—लता-वेष्ट, अस्, m., N.
of a mountain; a kind of coitus.
—लता-वेष्टन
or लता-वेष्टितक, अम्, n. ‘creeper-embrace,’ an
embrace or kind of embrace.
—लता-वेष्टित, अस्,
m., N. of a mountain.
—लता-शङ्ख, अस्, m.
Shorea Robusta.
—लतोद्गम (˚ता-उद्˚), अस्, m.
the upward climbing of a creeper.
लात, अस्, आ, अम्, taken, received, obtained.
लात लात, लाति, &c. See rt. 1. ला, p. 864.

लतिका, f. a small creeper or winding plant; a
string of pearls.
. fr. a Sautra rt. लत्, to hurt), a kind of lizard.
लतु लतु, उस्, m. a proper N.

लातव्य लातव्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from
Latu; N. of a chamberlain (in the Vikramorvaśī).
